covered.rule: Mail: M45 overrides only its named P15 rules; code list C is sole vocabulary; quoted 1 October settings obsolete
P15 1: first sentence automated assistant of Bank 5, call recorded; ask with title and last name
P15 2: never say collections, debt, payment, credit card, loan before verification
P15 3: ask once more, then unreached/unclear
P15 4: robot reply and scam reply, continue
P15 5: third party, say nothing, ask when reachable
P15 6 + M45 E: callback today or next business day, 09:00-19:00 inclusive, after now, unreached/callback
P15 7: outside window ask once more, else unreached/no_callback
P15 8: wrong number unreached/wrong_number
P15 9: deceased sentence, unreached/deceased
P15 10: refuse to talk no_arrangement/declined_payment
P15 11 + M45 A: postcode first (text, spaces removed), birth_year second (year, four digits)
P15 12 + M45 A: 5 wrong answers total, use wrong_answers_left
P15 13: failed instruction, unverified/failed
P15 14: explain once, second refusal unverified/declined; asking purpose counts
P15 15, 29 + M45 D: human request: ask once whether assistant can help, then desk / handed_over/person
P15 16: now clock, Mon-Sat, holidays 2026-10-14, 2026-10-15
P15 17: next <weekday> = following week
P15 18: collections team late payment intro; up to 2 products; state all; ask once pay all today
P15 19: floors and spoken names
P15 20: full first, never ask how much, floor once with 'the rest stays overdue'
P15 21: promise date rules
P15 22 table + M45 B: band1 3rd bd/1, band2 3rd bd/2, band3 12th bd/1
P15 23: attempt 1 full on last business day this week or next (floor if full refused), attempt 2 floor on deadline
P15 24: attempts used up -> note declined_payment
P15 25: already paid sentence, note settled, continue
P15 26: dispute note disputed, continue
P15 27: hardship sympathy, offer care, decline no_arrangement/distress, may record promise
P15 28: restructuring transfer restructure, handed_over/restructure, promises stay
P15 30: read-back 'Do you confirm?', one promise per product
P15 31: after-promise sentence
P15 32 + M45 C: retry 2 times, then no_arrangement/system_error
P15 33: change recorded promise reply
P15 34: same call, common date clamped, one read-back, transfer keeps promise
P15 35 + C: one note per unpromised product, reasons list, no notes on transfer
P15 36 + C: goodbye before close_call; outcome/reason table
P15 37: precedence arrangement / handed_over / settled / no_arrangement first non-paid
covered.where: outcomes.promise_outcome, transfer_outcome, transfer_overrides_promise, paid_outcome, all_paid_closes_as_paid, no_promise_outcome, no_promise_reason_from_first_non_paid_note

covered.rule: C: transfer queues care, desk, restructure

fixed: special_cases[hardship].say: was empty although P15 27 requires one short sentence of sympathy; added 'I am sorry to hear that.'

phrases.opening: removed the added 'Hello,' so the sentence states only the dictated content (automated assistant of Bank 5, call recorded); opening_verbatim stays false because the words are not dictated.
special_cases[human].trigger: made explicit that it covers requests during the identity check (P15 15) as well as after verification (P15 29), both governed by M45 D.
unresolved: No sentence is dictated for questions the assistant cannot answer (phrases.cannot_answer_sentence left empty).
How to interpret promise dates with missing parts is not stated.
Products with days late outside 1-62 are not covered by the band table.
M45 D says 'human requests' generally; applied to both the identity-check case (P15 15) and the post-verification case (P15 29) — the memo does not distinguish them explicitly.
verify_identity can return hint 'day_month_swapped', but no date question is used, so no hint_field/hint_reply is set.
